case.background: A capacitor is charged to a selected voltage and then discharged through a selected resistance. Determine its remaining voltage at a chosen elapsed time.
initial_observations: The voltage falls monotonically after the discharge switch is closed.

instruments.description: A charged capacitor, selectable resistor and capacitor, precision switch, timer, and high-impedance voltmeter.
instruments.name: rc_discharge_scope

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.
The time constant is dimensionally explicit: one kOhm*uF equals 0.001 seconds, so 50 kOhm and 20 uF give tau=1 second.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: capacitor_voltage_v. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.

readouts.description: Remaining capacitor voltage at the selected time.
readouts.name: capacitor_voltage_v
